name: Kholak
ingredients: Butter tea (Gur-gur chai) or salted water
instructions: 1. Take a clean bowl and add the roasted barley flour (Tsampa).
2. Gradually add warm butter tea or salted warm water while mixing with your fingers.
3. Add a small dollop of yak butter to the mixture for richness.
4. Knead the ingredients together by hand until it forms a firm, pliable, and non-sticky dough.
5. Shape the dough into small, bite-sized balls or patties.
6. Serve immediately as a nutritious, travel-friendly meal often paired with pickles or dried meat.
description: Kholak is a foundational dish in Ladakhi culture, representing the resourcefulness of mountain living. Often consumed by travelers and farmers, it provides sustained energy in high-altitude environments due to the high fiber and nutritional content of roasted barley.
